desc: Read the input $N$, sequence $A$, and sequence $B$.
Identify all indices $i$ where both $A_i$ and $B_i$ are not $-1$.
If there are any such indices, calculate their sums and verify that all sums are equal to a single constant $S$. If not, output "No".
If fully known pairs exist (S is fixed):
Check if for all $i$ where $B_i \neq -1$, $S \geq B_i$. If not, output "No".
Count frequencies of known values in $A$ (multiset $M_A$).
Count frequencies of required values in $U$ (indices where $B_i \neq -1$), where required value is $S - B_i$.
For every value $v$ in $M_A$, if $v > S$, check if count of $v$ in $M_A$ $\le$ count of $v$ in required values of $U$. If not, output "No".
If no fully known pairs exist, output "Yes".
Write the complete Python code to stdin/stdout.
